notes: Fresh-solved all 12 problems from display; all stored answers correct after the 3 duplicate-breaking edits. Added required 'expect' to every misconception (22 total), each committed as a real error and confirmed outside the accept window (inverse_error, wrong_ratio, wrong_Mr, forgot_step). Added a plain-text 'hint' to all 12 problems (gold tier had none, which failed the validator); kept every existing equation_hint verbatim. Added guided_steps to all 12 (mass->moles->ratio->mass chain with a reverse-check close; completion boundary phase:'substitute' set at the ratio-apply step so set-up is pre-worked and >=2 live finish boxes remain). Added tier_guides, opener, and three teach walks (2Ca+O2, 3Fe+2O2->Fe3O4, C3H8 combustion), none reusing bank numbers. Removed em dashes from method_card, exam_context.frequency, worked_examples labels and all messages (validator + house style). No unit-conversion boxes needed: all quantities already in base units (g, mol). No figures: pure-formula chemistry problems, no circuit/graph described. Board-neutral throughout: no board named, no equation-sheet claims (reacting-mass equations are recall for all boards anyway). LADDER NOTE: gold tier problems (G1 Al 2:2, G2 H2 2:2, G3 CH4 1:1) are all effectively 1:1 ratios, so they are not clearly harder than silver (which has genuine 2:1, 1:2 and 3:2 scaling); their 'gold' character is the less familiar equations and larger/derived Mr (AlCl3 = 133.5). Left bank order unchanged per spec guidance; teach/tier_guide examples deliberately show a stiffer 3:1 and 1:3 ratio to stretch the rung. B4 (moles from mass) and B5 (mole ratio) are single-skill building blocks, thinner than the mass-chain problems; their walks reverse-check to stay honest. Both rows verified byte-identical to the shard post-patch; validator PASS on the live canonical row.
